note: Authored paraphrases of selected shareable Cairn notes (source record/version recorded) plus authored neighbours and controls. No operational note body is copied verbatim. Distractors for collection-size cases are generated deterministically by scripts/trial_task_eval.py.

notes.body:
cairn: plain go test does not prove database coverage; use make test-integration

Project: cairn. Running `go test ./...` without a disposable test DSN skips the database-backed store tests and still reports ok. A very fast pass is the warning sign. Do not treat it as evidence for store or query changes. For database coverage run `make test-integration`, which provisions a disposable PostgreSQL cluster, then `make check`.

cairn: build deploy binaries from a clean clone, not a git worktree

Project: cairn deployment builds. A Go binary built inside a git worktree comes out without VCS stamps: Go silently skips stamping when .git is a file. Build deployment binaries from a clean clone of the commit, then check `go version -m BINARY` (or `cairn version`) reports the expected vcs.revision and vcs.modified=false before installing it.

cairn: Cairn deploy: build and verify from a clean clone of the commit

Project: cairn. For installation, clone the exact commit into a fresh directory, build there, and confirm the binary's recorded revision matches before replacing the installed binary. Keep the previous binary as a backup.

cairn: owner correction 2026-09-16: use local validation, not GitHub CI

Project: Cairn only. The owner said GitHub CI was failing and should not be used. The Actions workflow was removed and Actions disabled. Keep local gates instead: make test, make test-integration with disposable PostgreSQL, and make check before committing store changes. Do not add GitHub Actions workflows. Scope is the Cairn repository, not all repositories.

binkeeper: CUPS stays the default printer; Niimbot B1 is an optional choice

Project: binkeeper. The owner asked for the label service to "work with the B1"; an agent misread that as making the B1 the default and the owner corrected it. CUPS remains the default printer. The Niimbot B1 is an optional choice when printing or reprinting a label. Treat "work with X" as support for X, not as replacing the default.

binkeeper: nightly review scope is contents additions only

Project: binkeeper. The owner said a photo's failure to show an item must not prompt a removal. The nightly review proposes additions to bin contents only. It must not propose or apply removals, and must not revise the bin theme or main label that was set when the label was printed; manual theme editing remains available.

rhumb: never sweep the owner's staged files into agent commits

Project: rhumb. The owner keeps a staged, uncommitted research note in the index. An agent commit used the existing index and swept that note into pushed history. Before committing, commit only the agent's own paths (for example `git commit -- PATH`) or unstage the owner's files first, and confirm the owner's staged state is unchanged afterwards.

rhumb: replay corpus requires real-device exports with provenance

Project: rhumb. Replay corpus cases must use genuine device or app exports with recorded provenance. Generated or synthetic substitute files are forbidden. Case 38-fit-course needs a real Garmin course export and stays blocked until the owner supplies one; report the blocker instead of fabricating a file.

infra: update-bot must discover installed software, not only check a named target list

Project: infra update-bot. The owner's examples (opencode, python, python libraries) were treated as the scope boundary and the bot checked only a fixed list. The architecture requires a discovery and inventory loop: enumerate what is installed (OS packages, npm globals, uv and pipx tools, Python environments) and rediscover periodically. Owner examples are samples of a category, not the full scope.

surveyor: prefer fixing packet encoding over raising context capacity limits

Project: surveyor. When added response-schema metadata crowds a requested source excerpt out of a small-capacity backend packet, fix the packet encoding so the existing source-retention test passes at the current capacity limit. Do not raise the capacity limit; backend capacity is a fixed design boundary.

hermes: gateway exit status 1 on SIGTERM is intentional, not a fault

Project: Hermes gateway. On an external SIGTERM such as `systemctl --user restart hermes-gateway`, the gateway deliberately exits with code 1 so systemd Restart=on-failure revives it. journalctl then shows status=1/FAILURE and 'Failed with result exit-code'. This is not a crash. Confirm the signal came from systemd and check for OOM before treating it as a failure; do not change the exit code.

surveyor: Codex native output-schema option is incompatible with oneOf schemas

Project: surveyor. Codex's native structured-output (--output-schema) option rejects Surveyor's response schema because it contains `oneOf`; generation fails before it starts. Do not rely on it while the schema uses oneOf. Keep strict parser-side rejection of malformed JSON, or restructure the schema first.

newsroom: freshness/event-age score is advisory, not a hard gate

Project: newsroom digest. The freshness score is deliberately advisory: it is shown to the curator as {freshness=NN} with prompt guidance and never drops a candidate. The heuristic is imprecise in both directions, and an imprecise heuristic must not cost a day's digest. Undated candidates get no score rather than being treated as stale.

announce: quiet-hours override only on explicit owner request, per announcement

Project: announce. Quiet hours are 22:00-07:00 local time and suppress announcements by default; the urgent style does not bypass them. Override quiet hours only when the owner explicitly asks, for that single announcement, never as a persistent change or implied by urgency.

claude: Claude Code rejects Bash allow rules with mid-command wildcards

Project: Claude Code settings. A Bash(...) permission allow rule with `*` before the end of the command, such as `Bash(scripts/*.sh)`, triggers a startup warning because the wildcard also matches inserted options. Use exact values, or put `*` only at the end after the subcommand.

cairn: installing the codex shim must never write through an existing ~/.local/bin/codex symlink

Project: cairn installer. The real ~/.local/bin/codex is a symlink into the npm global install. Writing the launcher with write_text through that path overwrites the real Codex. Move the existing directory entry aside whole (symlink preserved) and atomically replace only the launcher entry; verify the symlink target bytes are unchanged.

infra: host provenance lives in ~/git/infra; ~/git/proximal and ~/git/homeassistant are gone

Project: host provenance. Provenance is consolidated in ~/git/infra with hosts/<host>/ (README.md, CHANGELOG.md, config/<subsystem>/). Record proximal host changes under ~/git/infra/hosts/proximal/, including a CHANGELOG entry. The former ~/git/proximal repository no longer exists; do not recreate it.

proximal: record host changes in the ~/git/proximal repo

Project: proximal host provenance (pre-consolidation). Host configuration changes for proximal are recorded in the ~/git/proximal repository: edit services/<name>.md and add a line to NOTES.md.

jev: tiny-model classifier size curve (supersedes the earlier 'tiny models collapse' lesson)

Project: showerthoughts/jev permission-gate classifier. On the balanced 64-command set, everything at or below 1.7B collapses to one class. Qwen3-4B Q8 reaches 0.73 agreement in JSON mode; Qwen3.5-4B Q8 reaches 0.77 in logprob mode (~500 ms). The best local option is the Kev-4B LoRA head on GPU in bf16 with flat question bodies (0.83-0.92 agreement at ~133 ms); dict-shaped question objects drop it to 0.67.

jev: tiny zero-shot GGUF classifiers collapse to one class

Project: showerthoughts/jev permission-gate classifier. Sub-1B instruct models (Gemma-3-270M, LFM2.5-350M) used as zero-shot or few-shot classifiers via logprobs or JSON output returned one risk level for every command. Conclusion at the time: a tiny zero-shot generative model is not a stand-in for jev; train a head instead.

halbritt: the Evernote export is ~/en_backup.db (evernote-backup SQLite), not ENEX

The owner's Evernote export on this host is an evernote-backup SQLite database at ~/en_backup.db. There are no .enex files; read notes from the SQLite tables.

binkeeper: photos are retained for 90 days

Project: binkeeper. Bin photos older than 90 days are deleted by the retention job; the latest photo per bin is always kept.

binkeeper: Niimbot B1 printing uses a BlueZ BLE driver, not CUPS/TSPL

Project: binkeeper. The B1 does not speak TSPL over CUPS. Print through the BlueZ-based BLE driver running under the hardened service account.

binkeeper: print intents must dedupe across printer backends

Project: binkeeper. A reprint request must be idempotent across CUPS and BLE backends; replaying the same intent must not print a second label.

binkeeper: label creation needs a fast path when the vision model is slow

Project: binkeeper. Offer a quick manual label path while the registration vision model is still running.

rhumb: multi-lineage merges need per-file three-way merges, not blanket --theirs

Project: rhumb. `git add -A` during a conflicted merge staged files with conflict markers, and blanket --theirs silently dropped the other lineage's change. Redo files changed by both lineages with git merge-file.

rhumb: prove runtime RED by neutralizing behavior, not by stashing files

Project: rhumb. Stashing feature files only gives compile-RED. Keep the API intact and neutralize the behavior with a minimal edit, run the gates, then revert.

rhumb: git stash push with a pathspec refuses staged deletions

Project: rhumb. `git stash push -- PATH` fails when the index holds staged deletions; stash the whole tree or restore the deletions first.

rhumb: no Garmin FIT SDK; own minimal FIT decoder

Project: rhumb. The app ships its own minimal FIT decoder rather than the Garmin SDK. Real exports must pass header CRC and layout checks.

rhumb: commit and push finished work at end of turn; publish only after merge

Project: rhumb. Finished work is committed and pushed at the end of each turn. Publish a release only after the branch is merged.

cairn: reproducing SIGTERM exit failures in integration checks

Project: cairn. Integration checks that stop the API must wait for the socket to close before asserting the exit status of the serve process.

cairn: require make check to pass before committing

Project: cairn. Run make check (go vet, gofmt, contract checks) before each commit.

cairn: Go httptest mock handler: avoid Server.Close hang with an unread body

Project: cairn. Give mock handlers an explicit release channel and close it before server.Close().

infra: verify source-built tool versions by revision, not package label

Project: infra update-bot. A matching npm version does not prove a source build is current; compare installed source revisions and report unknown versions as unknown.

infra: update-bot policy: what auto-updates vs stays manual

Project: infra update-bot. Independently maintained tools update automatically; project-pinned libraries are report-only; GPU drivers and the kernel stay manual.

surveyor: don't launch a continuation while the cross-family challenger is exhausted

Project: surveyor. Wait for the challenger family's quota to recover or substitute an approved backend.

surveyor: verify native-backend runs by admitted findings, not model exit

Project: surveyor. A zero exit from the model process does not show that findings were admitted; read findings.json.

infra: Hermes gateway activation only via a fresh zero-work native drain

Project: infra update-bot. Switch the running Hermes gateway only after a drain shows no in-flight work.

newsroom: aggregator echoes of old launches surface as fresh news

Project: newsroom digest. Page age is not event age; aggregator pages about old launches pass the publication-window gate.

announce: announce skill lives in skillpack

Project: announce. The announce skill is maintained in the skillpack repository; edit it there and redeploy.

cairn: restarting a Claude Code session: allow about 200 s for /exit and use the explicit channel flag

Project: cairn. Wait for the session to exit fully before resuming it with the channel flag in = form.

jev-docs: use the TypeSafe skill on this project

Project: jev-docs. Use the TypeSafe skill when working in jev-docs.

infra: Stream Deck keys call Home Assistant via local webhooks

Project: infra. Stream Deck buttons trigger Home Assistant local webhooks, so no token is stored on the client.

tools: prefer the standard csv module for small scripts

Project: tools. Small data scripts should use the standard library csv module rather than pandas.
